answer_2.quote: We use ... to calculate WER and SIM. For WER, we first transcribe the generated clips with Whisper-large-v3 and calculate WER with jiwer library ... We use the WER of audio generated without any emotion control (original voice cloning model) as a baseline ... Similar SIM between emotion‑controlled audio and baseline suggests our framework preserves speaker identity.

answer_4.quote: We asked one question for each emotion and each metric to 23 university student volunteers from our lab ... Participants compare audio samples ... selecting which better conveys the emotion.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were presented binary choice questions for each metric (e.g., which sample better conveys the emotion) and instructed that responses would be used to evaluate the new emotional TTS framework.
